description: Search Polish legal acts published in Dziennik Ustaw (DU, statutes and regulations) and Monitor Polski (MP, resolutions and announcements) by title, type, keywords, whether they are in force, and dates. Returns a compact list; get-act gives the details of one act and get-act-text its text.

dateEffectFrom.description: Earliest date of entry into force, in YYYY-MM-DD format

dateEffectTo.description: Latest date of entry into force, in YYYY-MM-DD format

dateFrom.description: Earliest date of the act (its signing), in YYYY-MM-DD format

dateTo.description: Latest date of the act (its signing), in YYYY-MM-DD format

inForce.description: true to return only acts in force

keywords.description: Keywords the acts must all have, exactly as listed by get-act-keywords (e.g. kodeks cywilny)

limit.description: Maximum number of acts to return; defaults to 20, at most 100

offset.description: Number of items to skip, for pagination; defaults to 0

pubDateFrom.description: Earliest publication date, in YYYY-MM-DD format

pubDateTo.description: Latest publication date, in YYYY-MM-DD format

publisher.description: Journal: DU for Dziennik Ustaw or MP for Monitor Polski

sortBy.description: Sort by publisher (default; newest acts first within a journal), position, title or change (time of the last change of the act's data)

title.description: Words to find in the title, in Polish (e.g. kodeks cywilny)

type.description: Type of act, e.g. Ustawa, Rozporządzenie, Obwieszczenie (consolidated texts are announced by one), Uchwała, Zarządzenie or Umowa międzynarodowa; several types separated by commas

name: search-acts

count.description: Number of acts in this response

ELI.description: European Legislation Identifier: publisher/year/position, e.g. DU/2024/1; its parts identify the act in get-act and get-act-text

announcementDate.description: Date of the act, i.e. of its signing (YYYY-MM-DD)

status.description: Legal status in Polish, e.g. obowiązujący or uchylony

textHTML.description: Whether get-act-text can return the text; otherwise the act is only a PDF

type.description: Type of act, e.g. Ustawa, Rozporządzenie or Obwieszczenie

notice.description: Set when the Sejm API is unavailable and the data comes from a cache; it may be out of date

totalCount.description: Number of acts that match the search

title: Search legal acts
